# PR #152 round 6 correctness verdict

## Documenting regression

`a_client_replaying_a_live_seats_pane_still_replies_as_it_until_req_10` uses the real HTTP router/store with fake pane/process observations:

- The fixture registers pij-holder at %51. Its setup does not seed holder-to-pij-second delivery jobs.
- A fresh native HTTP client overrides the normal test caller with %51 and names pij-holder as from. A separate shim HTTP client supplies the same victim pane; the shim derives its sender.
- Both responses succeed. The real jobs table contains two live ordinary deliveries to pij-second from pij-holder. The assertion therefore demonstrates the claimed visible send-as effect on both paths, not merely two success envelopes.
- The comment explicitly calls this a documenting residual, names PRD 003 req-10/plan 221 phase 2 and requires refusal assertions when send-as is gated. It does not claim caller-process provenance or model completion.

The comment, PR body's Known limit and API paragraph match governance commit **0d4a40be**, C32: pane resolution is registration strength, not proof the requesting process runs there. The accepted residual is explicitly linked to existing uncorrelated raw-from send-as. This is not a finding waived by pretending the metadata is private.

## Queue assertion repair

The old peek_inbox helper could observe only the head job. The new query reads all pending/running jobs of exactly `delivery:<seat>`, oldest first, then filters the expected sender. Those are the queue's actual live states and ordinary-delivery kind.

The current production DeliveryPayload flattens Msg fields at the root; the helper handles that shape, plus wrapped message objects. I checked the relevant refusal/positive callers: queued jobs from the asserted holder are now counted beyond the head; held FYIs, answered_at and request.answered_by_reply remain separate assertions. The new two-delivery regression is also a positive witness that the helper sees more than one queued message.

No existing valid-payload assertion was weakened to compensate for the broader read. All **82 directory_http cases executed and passed** at this exact head, including the unbound/asserted refusal matrix, paneless metadata replay, closed-request gate, role-reply positive and OMP wire-fixture positive.

CI **42407240181** is success at the exact full SHA. Its JUnit has **2162 cases, zero failures/errors**; all 82 directory cases are unskipped, including the new pane-replay test. Latest Delivers is success. The detached checkout is clean, matches the remote pin, and GitHub reports CLEAN/ready.

No local product tests/builds, mutations, dependency changes or live probes. This is HTTP replay with fake pane facts, not a live TS-to-daemon or macOS caller-origin proof. No new recurring production cost exists in this delta.
